scope: The same 217 vectors through an independent Java validator, which computes the check digits by building the expanded digit string and taking one big-integer modulus.
static_analysis: automation/a18_run_b.py contains no validation logic at all. It launches the Java program and reads back what it said; putting any part of the decision there would put RUN-A's runtime back inside RUN-B. Every input line is prefixed with a marker so that an empty IBAN is still one input and cannot be lost in a blank line.

target.identity_evidence: same digest RUN-A was bound to

independence.algorithm_shape: expanded digit string and one big-integer modulus, not a streaming fold
